ORDINANCE




BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the PD 1302,
Planned Development District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-F in the
area bound by:

      West Diversey Parkway; North Lehmann Court; a line 175 feet south of and parallel to
      West Diversey Parkway; and the public alley next west of North Lehmann Court,

to those of an B3-5, Community Shopping District.



SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        ____________________________
                                                        Timothy Knudsen
                                                        Alderman, 43rd Ward




Common Address:
601-609 W. Diversey Parkway and 2726 – 2736 N. Lehmann Court
